outcome: diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) disorders (FIGO classification)
cohort: The study included 556 high-risk PAS patients, defined as those with placenta previa or a history of previous cesarean sections.
finding: Four specific MRI signs (bladder wall interruption, placental ischemic infarction, placental protrusion, and myometrial thinning) were identified as significant and reliable independent predictors of invasive PAS.
